s: A company has an on-premises monitoring solution using a PostgreSQL database for persistence of events. The database is unable to scale due to heavy ingestion and it frequently runs out of storage. The company wants to create a hybrid solution and has already set up a VPN connection between its network and AWS. The solution should include the following attributes: Managed AWS services to minimize operational complexity A buffer that automatically scales to match the throughput of data and requires no on-going administration. A visualization toot to create dashboards to observe events in near-real time. Support for semi -structured JSON data and dynamic schemas. Which combination of components will enabled© company to create a monitoring solution that will satisfy these requirements'' (Select TWO.)
o: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to buffer events Create an AWS Lambda function 10 process and transform events
Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream to buffer events Create an AWS Lambda function to process and transform evens
Configure an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster to receive events Use Amazon Quick Sight to read from the database and create near-real-time visualizations and dashboards
Configure Amazon Elastic search Service (Amazon ES) to receive events Use the Kibana endpoint deployed with Amazon ES to create near-real-time visualizations and dashboards.
Configure an Amazon Neptune 0 DB instance to receive events Use Amazon QuickSight to read from the database and create near-real-time visualizations and dashboards

w.y: The buffer must scale automatically with no administration, which is Kinesis Data Firehose (Kinesis Data Streams needs shard management in provisioned mode). Semi-structured JSON with dynamic schemas plus near-real-time dashboards points to Amazon OpenSearch Service (formerly Elasticsearch) with Kibana/OpenSearch Dashboards, which Firehose can deliver to directly.

o.A: Correct: Firehose scales automatically with no ongoing administration and can invoke Lambda to transform records.
o.B: A Kinesis data stream in provisioned mode requires shard capacity management, so it does not meet 'no ongoing administration'.
o.C: Aurora PostgreSQL needs a fixed relational schema and QuickSight is not a near-real-time event dashboard for streaming data.
o.D: Correct: OpenSearch/Elasticsearch indexes schemaless JSON and Kibana gives near-real-time dashboards, all managed.
o.E: Neptune is a graph database, not suited to event analytics or dynamic JSON dashboards.
